NutriSnap
Hover. Detect. Know. — The Indian Food Tracker Young India Actually Needs
iQOO Hackathon 2026 · Bengaluru · 13–14 June 2026
Track: On-Device AI · Domain: Health & Wellness · Solo Build

Your Idea

NutriSnap  is  a  zero-friction,  on-device  AI  nutrition  assistant  built  specifically  for  Indian  meals  and  the
young, health-conscious generation that wants to eat better but finds existing apps too tedious to stick
with.  The  core  interaction  is  unlike  anything  that  exists  today:  tap  a  home  screen  widget,  hover  your
iQOO phone over your thali or plate, and within seconds a floating report appears — dishes detected,
macro  breakdown,  and  a  verdict  based  on  your  personal  goal  (lose  weight,  build  muscle,  manage
energy).  No  photo  taken.  No  app  opened.  No  typing.  The  entire  interaction  is  under  5  seconds.  The

The Numbers
According to ICMR, over 77 million Indians have diabetes — the fastest-growing cohort is adults under
35.  Add  a  post-COVID  generation  hyper-aware  of  immunity,  weight,  and  energy  levels.  There  is  a
massive, unmet need.

How the Hover Detection Works

Unlike every existing food app that requires you to snap a photo, NutriSnap runs the AI model continuously
on  the  live  camera  feed  using  CameraX  +  TensorFlow  Lite.  When  the  model's  confidence  for  detected
dishes  crosses  85%,  it  auto-locks  the  frame,  generates  the  report,  and  dismisses  the  camera.  The  user
sees it as magic — hover and know.
Goal-Based Feedback Engine
Users set one goal on first launch. Every output is filtered through that goal — no confusing numbers, just
clear verdicts.

Technical Stack
LayerTechnology & Rationale
On-device vision modelTensorFlow Lite + MobileNetV3 — fast, small, runs on iQOO NPU
Indian food datasetIndian Food-81 (Kaggle) — 80 dish categories, fine-tuned
Live camera inferenceCameraX Jetpack — continuous frame analysis, no shutter
Home screen widgetAndroid App Widget (RemoteViews) — one tap entry point
Floating reportAndroid System Overlay — appears without opening the app
Local data logRoom Database (SQLite) — offline, instant, private
LanguageKotlin (Android) + Python (model training and TFLite export)
